days.title: Central Peaks and Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Rondslottet
stops.detail: The highest mountain peak in the national park is Rondslottet at 2,178 m.

stops.name: Rondvatnet
stops.detail: Between the steeply sloping sides of this valley lies the narrow lake Rondvatnet, which also forms the center of the park.

stops.name: Storronden
stops.detail: The highest peaks are Rondslottet (the Rond Castle) at 2,178 m, Storronden (the Great Rond) at 2,138 m and Høgronden (the High Rond) at 2,118 m height.

stops.name: Rondvassbu
stops.detail: In Rondane, there is the central cabin Rondvassbu at the southern end of Lake Rondvatnet.

days.title: Gorges and Archaeological Sites
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Jutulhogget
stops.detail: Rondane contains several small gorges (the best known are Jutulhogget and Vesle-Ula) that were carved by meltwater.

stops.name: Gravhø
stops.detail: The large traps used for catching reindeer can be visited at Gravhø and at Bløyvangen and are also common throughout the park.
